h1: Custom Men's Pedometers for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom men's pedometers in bulk. Perfect for corporate wellness programs and employee fitness challenges.
introHtml: Custom men's pedometers are designed with larger clips and rugged finishes that hold up on belts and pockets during active days. If you are equipping a sales team or a warehouse crew, these pedometers offer step tracking without a bulky wristband. They work well for step challenges and wellness programs where employees want a simple clip-on device. Add your logo with a crisp screen print or laser engraving to keep your brand visible all day.
heroAltText: Custom men's pedometer with step counter display and metal clip, suitable for corporate wellness programs
